item.title: Version 1.5.11
item.changes: Prism has a new Fringe slider: set it to 0 for crisp copies with no color split Painting a Lens Effects layer's mask no longer makes the effect shift or soften while you paint The color picker's OK and Cancel buttons fix rare bug that left the picker stuck open Holding Space to pan now shows the hand steadily, with no cursor flicker in the selection tools and the eyedropper included The Hand tool has a new open-palm icon
